label: rare copy-phase echo of w/l/a/s (no capturable rule)
explanation: Very sparse (0.014% of steps). 86% of activation mass is in the copy phase, about half of it at recall_idx 1, where the input is orig(0) fed back after <DEL>. Activity is concentrated on fed-back inputs w, l, a, s (77% of mass) and is enriched when the sequence is long (L 7-9), has many digits, and the current or next output is 2, 3, c, j, k, h or u. It is near zero for t < 4 and on the first occurrence of a token. But these conditions only enrich the rate; they do not decide it. Copy-phase steps with input w/l/a/s fire only 0.2% of the time, and the best conjunction tried (recall_idx 1, these inputs, these out/next_out tokens) reached dev F1 0.11. Activation magnitude is narrow (0.10-0.20), and no tested variable separated high from low activations. No coherent predicate found; the recorded predicate is the high-recall, very-low-precision superset.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: w, c, s, l, a, 2; least: e, b, m, h) and the third original token (most: 2, h, u, 3, j, l; least: d, 0, o, m); timing cues that raise it most: L=5 & t=4, L=9 & t=10, L=8 & t=9.
